definitions.length: Unicode character count, matching the existing round quality check.
definitions.guessing: Always choose an extreme length; choose uniformly among tied extremes. Random baseline is 25%. These are not user scores.
definitions.flag: Correct option alone is longest and exceeds the next longest by >=10 characters, or is >1.4 times the other three mean lengths. A flag requires semantic review.
definitions.scope: daily_article and home_legacy are editable candidates; legacy_fixed is a dated standalone snapshot, preserved.
definitions.publication: Existing daily/article/passage snapshots retain their original options and keys. Source edits apply to future rounds.

policy: Review meaningful distractors and matching explanations; check longest AND shortest cues. Do not pad options, exclude answers by length, or treat a revision as a new context or attempt.
